translation: Salty in flavor, neutral, non-toxic. It treats cough with rebellion and chest bi (咳逆胸痹), lumbar pain and hypochondriac urgency (脅急), rat [fistula] (鼠[blank]), bleeding from the great orifice (大孔出血), and flooding and leaking from the center (崩中漏下). It grows in the East Sea, has markings (文), and is gathered at any season.
